The 5T OTA has its inputs reversed, so the loop has positive feedback and the output latches to VDD. On the diode side of the mirror (M1), a rising gate pulls vout up. That makes M1's gate the non-inverting input (vinp), and M2's gate the inverting input (vinn). This edit swaps them and lengthens the diff-pair, load and tail devices to add gain and CMRR margin.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Inputs were swapped, so the loop had positive feedback and vout latched at VDD (M1 and M4 in triode). The diode-side device must take vinp. Longer diff-pair, load and tail L raise gain and CMRR margin, which are marginal (42.75 dB, 59.65 dB predicted)."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1":  (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),
    "L1":     (2.0, 0.8, 3.0),
    "itail":  (7.0e-6, 5.5e-6, 8.2e-6),
    "gmid_l": (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),
    "L_l":    (3.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_t": (10.0, 6.0, 14.0),
    "L_t":    (3.0, 1.0, 4.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    it = p["itail"]
    i1 = it / 2.0

    mref0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mref = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], iref, vds=mref0.vgs)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmid_t"], p["L_t"], it, vds=0.35)

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], i1, vds=0.55, vsb=0.35)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_l"], p["L_l"], i1, vds=0.9)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MREF", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mref)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # diode-side device takes vinp -> non-inverting at vout
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    gout = m1.gds + m3.gds
    a0 = gm1 / gout
    cout = cl + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cout)
    cx = 2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fp2 = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cx)
    pm = 90.0 - math.degrees(math.atan(gbw / fp2)) * 0.5
    sr = it / cout
    tau = 1.0 / (2 * PI * gbw)
    settle = max(0.0, 0.5 / sr - tau) + 4.6 * tau
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    sv = 16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(sv) * 3.0
    cmrr = db(max(2 * gm1 / mt.gds * (m3.gm / (m3.gds + 1e-12)) / 50.0, 1.0))
    psrr = db(a0)
    vtail = 0.9 - m1.vgs
    swing = (vdd - m3.vdsat - 0.05) - (vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05)
    power = vdd * (iref + it)

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(a0), "ugbw": gbw, "pm": pm, "noise_1k": noise,
        "cmrr_db": cmrr, "psrr_db": psrr, "slew": sr, "settle": settle,
        "power": power, "swing": swing,
    }
```
